name: Free Theme Builder for Elementor – CRT Addons (Header, Footer, Archive, WooCommerce & 50+ Widgets)
author: CRThemes

sections.description:
CRT Addons for Elementor

Stop paying for Elementor Pro! CRT Addons for Elementor (crt-manage) is the ultimate free alternative that unlocks advanced Pro features for your favorite page builder. Easily design custom headers, footers, archive pages, single posts, and WooCommerce layouts without writing a single line of code.Whether you are a freelancer building client sites or a DIY website owner, this plugin supercharges your Elementor experience with lightweight, highly-optimized widgets and layouts.

🌟Key Features (Everything is 100% FREE)

Complete Elementor Theme Builder: Create unlimited custom Headers, Footers, 404 Pages, Single Post layouts, and Archive pages.
WooCommerce Builder: Design stunning shop pages, custom single product layouts, and product archives to increase conversion rates.
50+ Premium Elementor Widgets: Access advanced widgets including Advanced Sliders, Before/After Image Sliders, Mega Menu, Testimonials, Portfolio Grids, and Price Tables.
1-Click Demo Import Ready: Perfectly optimized to work with lightweight starter themes.
White-Label Support for Agencies: Easily clean up the admin dashboard for your design clients.
SEO & Speed Optimized: Zero bloat code. Clean PHP and Javascript ensure your website loads under 1 second and scores high on Google Core Web Vitals.

🎨 Seamless Integration with Best Starter Themes

Looking for the perfect, lightning-fast theme to pair with this plugin? CRT Addons is fully integrated and optimized for CRThemes Premium & Free Templates (including Teri Shop eCommerce, Pascal News, and Egan Portfolio).
👉 Explore our agency-ready themes at: https://crthemes.com

🚀 50+ Powerful Widgets Included:

Marketing: Pricing Table, Call to Action, Team Members, Testimonial Carousel.
Creative: Before/After Image, Advanced Slider, Flip Box, Interactive Cards.
Content: Post Grid, Post Masonry, Custom Meta, Advanced Accordion.
WooCommerce: Product Grid, Add to Cart Button, Product Price, Product Rating.

🛠️ How to Get Started in 3 Steps:

  1. Click Download or search for “CRT Addons” directly in your WordPress Dashboard (Plugins > Add New).
  2. Activate the plugin and navigate to the CRT Addons menu.
  3. Start creating your custom Header, Footer, or choose from our recommended templates to build your website in minutes!

❤ Love CRT Addons?

If our plugin saved you from buying Elementor Pro, please leave us a ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ review! Your feedback helps us build more free widgets and features for the community.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/crt-manage directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open any page in the Elementor Editor and begin dragging and dropping the new CRT widgets onto your canvas.
